Option a refuses different parameterDigest across configurations. A rule can validly compute different metric values for the same logical subject in different configurations. Preserve each occurrence payload or explicitly establish why a specific invariant must agree; do not silently reject ordinary evidence.

Using none/count-at-most/all-covered does not itself make an advisory rule mandatory/gating. Unknown truth and enforcement obligation are separate. Keep required capability execution and EvidenceUse requirements distinct, with profile-specific comparison gating.

Unknown export membership concerns candidate selection, not the truth of a per-subject atom for a known selected subject. Evaluate known subjects under their own relation coverage; retain independent enumeration uncertainty even when some root predicates are true.
Conditional disclosure only when emitWhen is not true would lose the deficiency after waiving a known true finding. A waiver cannot cure enumeration uncertainty.
